```plato

    //==
    // # Reading a polyhedron
    //
    // The measurements a Conway program is judged by. Every one is a fold over
    // the face or corner numbering, so they hold for any closed polygon mesh and
    // not only for the catalog above.
    //
    // Two of them are named away from the `IVolume` obligations
    // (`geometry.concepts.plato`) on purpose: `PolygonMesh3D` is a combinatorial
    // boundary that may be open or non-convex, so it does not claim to be a solid
    // with a volume — `EnclosedVolume` and `TotalFaceArea` are readings that
    // happen to coincide with those obligations when the mesh IS closed and
    // outward-wound, and are meaningless when it is not.

    // The area of one face: the magnitude of its Newell vector area
    // (`polygons.library.plato`). Exact for a planar face and the least-squares
    // reading of a nearly planar one, which is the same bargain `FaceUnitNormal`
    // makes.
    FaceArea(self: PolygonMesh3D, face: Integer): Number
        => self.FacePositions(face).VectorArea.Magnitude;
```
